s: LORD speaks to Joshua (instructing him about the cities of refuge)
q: The LORD spoke to Joshua, saying,

s: cities of refuge (for the man slayer) serves alien (alien living among Israel) (also appointed for the alien living among them)
q: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the alien who lives among them,

s: cities of refuge (for the man slayer) serves children of Israel (appointed for all of them)
q: These were the appointed cities for all the children of Israel, and for the alien who lives among them,

s: man slayer (unintentional killer) is a person who kills accidentally or unintentionally
q: the man slayer who kills any person accidentally or unintentionally may flee there.

s: man slayer (unintentional killer) receives from elders a place to live in the city (after declaring his case at the gate)
q: They shall take him into the city with them, and give him a place, that he may live among them.

s: man slayer (unintentional killer) dwells in city of refuge (until he stands before the congregation for judgment and until the high priest dies)
q: He shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days.

s: man slayer (unintentional killer) returns to his own city and house (after the high priest's death)
q: Then the man slayer shall return, and come to his own city, and to his own house, to the city he fled from.’”

s: avenger of blood may not receive man slayer (unintentional killer) (the city's elders must not deliver him up because he killed unintentionally and bore no prior hatred)
q: If the avenger of blood pursues him, then they shall not deliver up the man slayer into his hand; because he struck his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him before.

s: elders (elders of the city of refuge) hears man slayer (unintentional killer) (he declares his case in their ears at the city gate)
q: and declare his case in the ears of the elders of that city.

q: Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali,

q: Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim,

q: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

s: cities of refuge (for the man slayer) includes Ramoth (in Gilead, from the tribe of Gad)
q: Beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness in the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

q: for the LORD your God, he is God in heaven above, and on earth beneath
